notes: Sourced from Plura Inc.'s current official product/spec page for the BrightEye NXT 950 (Ensemble Designs was acquired by Plura Broadcast; plurainc.com/products/be950/ is now the manufacturer's live spec source and superseded the old ensembledesigns.com URL, which 404s). Specs cross-checked against the AV-iQ catalog listing (av-iq.com) and confirmed against a photographed rear-panel diagram (be_nxt_950_rear.webp on plurainc.com) that labels every physical port. SDI/BNC channels top out at 2.97 Gb/s (3G-SDI, SMPTE 424M/425M) — no 6G/12G-SDI support, so grade sdi-3g. Ethernet is stated as 10/100 Mb/s only (eth-100m). The unit also supports 4K as a quad-link signal, but this reuses the same four Ch In / Ch Out BNCs (no separate "4K" connector exists on the rear panel). This is a compact 1/3-rack-width module (5.63"W x 1.65"H x 6.75"D); the datasheet states "rackmount up to three NXT 950s in 1RU" via an accessory shelf/frame — rackUnits is set to 1 as the minimum mounting increment, not a literal per-unit RU claim. Manufacturer field kept as "Ensemble Designs" (the brand printed on the unit itself) even though the parent company is now Plura Inc.

ports.name: Ref In
ports.note: 1V p-p composite/tri-level reference sync input, analog — not a digital SDI signal, so no bandwidth grade applies

ports.name: SFP I/O A/B
ports.note: Pluggable module cage assignable to input or output; accepts SDI/fiber, HDMI, or IP (SMPTE 2022) modules depending on which SFP is inserted — no single fixed grade

ports.name: SFP I/O C/D
ports.note: Pluggable module cage assignable to input or output; accepts SDI/fiber, HDMI, or IP (SMPTE 2022) modules depending on which SFP is inserted — no single fixed grade

ports.name: DC Power
ports.note: Rear panel silkscreened 'GND / +12VDC / 5A' — a locking coaxial DC connector (not a plain unlocked barrel jack), closest listed id is dc-barrel. Powered by an included external 100-230VAC modular power supply (12V, 35W typical draw).
